Strict convex equality, exact variance range and continuum via SO(n) follow. The executable verify.py confirms exact rational cases and numerical zero-diagonal constructions without replacing the proof.

value.rationale: Single-pivot diagonal-proportional Cholesky is a fundamental kernel/Nyström primitive, and its residual trace is the main algorithmic accuracy variable. Sharp simultaneous convex-order envelopes over every real fixed-spectrum matrix distinguish invariant expected trace error from all convex risk measures. An attainable zero-variance basis for every spectrum and an attained size-biased eigenvalue worst law provide a complete structural boundary, with exact variance maxima and a simple (9,1) contrast. Neither the proof's elementary ingredients nor novelty searches alone establish value: its value is the complete attainable distributional extremum for a natural sampling primitive.
